# Attack Roll

*[Rules Glossary](../../index.md) > [Combat > Attacks](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#AttackRoll)*

An attack roll is a [D20 Test](../../D20-Tests/D20-Test.md) that represents making an attack with a weapon, an [Unarmed Strike](Unarmed-Strike.md), or a spell. *See also* "Playing the Game" ("[D20 Tests](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/playing-the-game#AttackRolls)").
